name: Europen Endustri Insaat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
summary: Europen Endustri Insaat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. provides PVC profiles, door and window, and glass products in Turkey. It offers profile, sheet, panel, PVC window, PVC door, refrigerator glass, oven glasses, furniture glass, and solar panel glass products. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Eskisehir, Turkey.
